about: The clip kit's recipes (tools/clips/make.mjs, docs/tools/clips.md). One recipe is one clip: a scene of the capture hook (render/tools/flash_capture.gd) or a mockup script, the seed, the page words, a tick window (from + frames x step) or an event window, a crop of the 960x540 picture, and the encoding. The sim is deterministic, so a recipe gives the same clip on the same build, and moves to a newer build with nobody looking. `nohud=1` hides the HUD on builds whose hook has it; the crops also keep the HUD's corners out, so an older build works too.

events.about: Names a recipe's `event` can use, matched against the sim's own events the hook logs (type, kind). Any other name is read as type or type:kind.

bookmarks.about: Windows (ticks before and after) for the marks and bookmarks of a saved match (make.mjs --from-match): the game's own launch, crater, beam clash end, building fall and KO, and the player's clip button (F9, or View + RB), which marks the last 15 seconds.

selftest.desc: A short clip for the kit's self-test: the beam clash staging, 12 frames of the struggle's blast (works on builds whose hook is older than the film scenes).

charged-strike.desc: A right stick held 60 ticks toward the rival, then released and landing: the stick's charged strike.
charged-strike.needs: a build with the film scenes (the hook of 2026-11-06 on)

chase.desc: A launch, the tap, the rush and the catch, in the split view.
chase.needs: a build with the film scenes and the chase tap

beam-and-shove.desc: A beam charged and fired standing still at point-blank; the rival is shoved away.

beam-struggle.desc: Both beams meeting in the village, then the blast and the crater at the clash.

top-power-towers.desc: A top-power launch through the tower row, the burn streak and the rubble thrown at the start.
top-power-towers.needs: a build with the film scenes and the power park (power=1)

building-gives-way.desc: A city building's cracked charcoal wall drops, with stone rubble and dust, the two fighters in front.

planet-today-vs-plates.desc: MOCKUP: planet 7 today beside the plate terrain, two globes turning slowly, drawn from World's flat maps (not the game's globe).

megastructures-pan.desc: MOCKUP: a slow pan across the bottom row of Art's megastructure sheet, the card text left out.

beam-clash-1-low-side-on.desc: Camera's film shot 1: low and side on, a push in and a drift as he fires; the struggle held still.
beam-clash-1-low-side-on.needs: Camera's clip-scenes park (main.gd and sim_host.gd hunks) landed

beam-clash-2-high-wide-over-town.desc: Camera's film shot 2: high and wide over the town, craning down and easing in.

beam-clash-3-tight-then-pull-back.desc: Camera's film shot 3: tight on P1 charging, across to P2, then a pull back as the beams meet.

first-launch.desc: An event window, as an example: the first launch of an AI match, 60 ticks before to 90 after.

first-clash-end.desc: An event window: the end of the first beam struggle (needs Encounter's clash-end park, beamStruggle.endEvent on).
first-clash-end.needs: Encounter's clash-end park with its switch on
